profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Full-stack software engineer with 4+ years of experience, including 2 years as a tech lead. I build and maintain web applications end to end with Laravel, Node.js/TypeScript, and React, and I lead teams through architecture, mentoring, and delivery.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: MySQL · Vue.js · Agile Methodologies · Programming Languages · Database Queries · PHP · React.js · PhpStorm · Problem Solving · Front-end Coding · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Phpstan · Software Design · JavaScript · Redis · Laravel · Bitbucket · Code Review

positions.title: SMC Incident Analyst/ IT Support
positions.description:
●	Provide remote connection support to end-users.
●	Assisting backup engineering team with monitoring and daily management of Legato and Data Protector Environments
●	Performing scheduled hands & eyes backup tasks per customer processes. This includes racking and cabling of equipment, removal of devices, storage, and shipping.
●	Training and orienting staff on use of hardware and software.
●	Performing application tasks for managed customers. This includes stop/start commands and execution of scripts on UNIX applications for managed customers.
●	Tracking tickets until final resolution in platforms such as ServiceNow, BMC and Smax.

positions.title: EVV/ IT Specialist
positions.description:
•	Installing and updating software for the office staff. 
•	Manage logistics and hardware installation for a new office in Broward County. 
•	Manage the integration process for a new EVV vendor. 
•	Create company website and domain (maximumcarehh.com). 
•	Troubleshoot the EVV app on caregivers’ phones.
•	Schedule visits confirmation process.

positions.title: Production Operator
positions.description:
•	Monitored production line efficiency to ensure timely load and shipment.
•	Completed quality assurance testing on goods and products. 
•	Organized inventory in an easy-to-access process.  
•	Improved the workflow by prioritizing projects based on importance and minimizing unnecessary interruptions.

positions.title: Assistant Manager
positions.description:
•	Hired and trained new employees.
•	Created effective sales strategies relevant to retailing each product and service. 
•	Conducted monthly meetings to evaluate employees and train them in new sales techniques.
•	Ordered products from +10 vendors for each of the 6 stores.  
•	Handled cash deposits and performed unannounced audits to the stores.

company.name: Metro Solutions, Authorized Dealership of MetroPCS

positions.title: Salesperson
positions.description:
•	Presented, promoted and sold products/services using solid arguments to existing and prospective customers. 
•	Established, developed and maintained positive business and customer relationships.
•	Opened and closed cash registers/ stores. 
•	Completed daily inventory checks.
•	Greeted customers and met their visit expectations. 
•	Maintained sales metrics by making payments conversions.
